mutants.name: failure_not_rejected
mutants.reason: A native validation failure leaves the observation ADMITTED instead of NATIVE_REJECTED, so it keeps its pin and blocks the next admission.

mutants.name: recovery_skips_admitted
mutants.reason: The recovery driver does not re-execute the saved ADMITTED obligation, so GoLive is refused and startup fails.

mutants.name: resume_any_block
mutants.reason: RECOVERY_ONLY treats another block as the saved obligation instead of refusing it with ErrMode.

mutants.reason: The pin adapter reports a release without removing the pin, so abandoned and rejected observations keep their pins.

mutants.name: release_absent_pin_fails
mutants.reason: The pin adapter passes ErrUnknownPin through, so the Abandon of an observation without a pin fails and startup stops.

mutants.name: window_short
mutants.reason: The capsule leaves out the lowest BLOCKHASH window header, so the window check refuses the observation after ADMITTED.

mutants.name: get_hash_native
mutants.reason: Native execution answers BLOCKHASH from its own chain instead of the saved capsule headers; no lookup reaches the capsule.

mutants.name: safe_point_untraced
mutants.reason: An execution with a safe point runs the generated loop, which has no safe point, so no CALL input is captured.
